title: GrammarNote
description: Why an English sentence is built the way it is, explained in Hindi. The translation says what a sentence means; this says how it works, which is the wall a reader hits once the words stop being the problem.

source.description: The sentence explained, as it was sent.

shape.description: एक पंक्ति में वाक्य की बनावट — the one-line shape of the sentence in Hindi, e.g. "कर्ता + had been + क्रिया-ing — बीते समय में चलता रहा काम।"

points.description: The two or three things worth noticing, each tied to the words it is about.

part.description: The words from the sentence this is about, copied exactly.

label.description: What it is, in Hindi (काल, कर्मवाच्य, सर्वनाम का संदर्भ…).

note.description: Why it is there and what it does, in Hindi, in a sentence or two.
